calendar_plan_lists_scope_shape.name: calendar_plan_lists_scope_shape
calendar_plan_lists_scope_shape.value: ("calendar_plan_lists"."scope" = 'template' AND "calendar_plan_lists"."weekday" IS NOT NULL AND "calendar_plan_lists"."weekday" BETWEEN 1 AND 7 AND "calendar_plan_lists"."local_date" IS NULL) OR ("calendar_plan_lists"."scope" = 'date' AND "calendar_plan_lists"."weekday" IS NULL AND "calendar_plan_lists"."local_date" IS NOT NULL)

explore_jobs_shape.name: explore_jobs_shape
explore_jobs_shape.value: "explore_rebuild_jobs"."kind" IN ('common','view') AND "explore_rebuild_jobs"."state" IN ('running','ready','failed') AND "explore_rebuild_jobs"."fence" BETWEEN 1 AND 3 AND char_length("explore_rebuild_jobs"."id") = 64

explore_snapshots_shape.name: explore_snapshots_shape
explore_snapshots_shape.value: "explore_snapshots"."kind" IN ('common','view') AND char_length("explore_snapshots"."id") = 64 AND ("explore_snapshots"."kind" = 'common') = ("explore_snapshots"."visibility_revision" IS NULL)

friend_requests_requesting_scope_shape.name: friend_requests_requesting_scope_shape
friend_requests_requesting_scope_shape.value: ("friend_requests"."requesting_scope" = 'profile' AND "friend_requests"."requesting_profile_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("friend_requests"."requesting_scope" = 'family' AND "friend_requests"."requesting_profile_id" IS NULL)

friend_requests_target_scope_shape.name: friend_requests_target_scope_shape
friend_requests_target_scope_shape.value: ("friend_requests"."target_scope" = 'profile' AND "friend_requests"."target_profile_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("friend_requests"."target_scope" = 'family' AND "friend_requests"."target_profile_id" IS NULL)

lesson_audiences_target_required.name: lesson_audiences_target_required
lesson_audiences_target_required.value: "lesson_audiences"."target_family_id" IS NOT NULL OR "lesson_audiences"."target_profile_id" IS NOT NULL

town_raft_pickup_shape.name: town_raft_pickup_shape
town_raft_pickup_shape.value: ("town_raft_items"."picked_at" IS NULL AND "town_raft_items"."pickup_request_id" IS NULL) OR ("town_raft_items"."picked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "town_raft_items"."pickup_request_id" IS NOT NULL)
